# Prince Yadav — Zoho Developer & CRM/ERP Consultant

> Direct personal consulting and hands-on Zoho development for businesses across the US, Europe, Middle East, and Asia.

## About Prince Yadav
Prince Yadav is a Zoho Developer and CRM/ERP Consultant with 2+ years of professional experience, 16+ client engagements across 6+ countries (India, Saudi Arabia, UAE, Japan, USA, Italy), 30+ custom modules delivered, 50+ automations deployed, and 400,000+ records migrated.

## Primary Services
- **Zoho CRM Development**: Custom module architecture, Blueprint sales processes, Deluge automation, lead scoring, and pipeline optimization. URL: https://princeyadav7.github.io/princeyadav.github.io/services/zoho-crm-development/
- **Zoho One Consulting**: Multi-app implementation connecting CRM, Books, Inventory, Desk, Sign, and Analytics with zero data silos. URL: https://princeyadav7.github.io/princeyadav.github.io/services/zoho-one-consulting/
- **Zoho Creator Development**: Custom low-code business applications, client portals, and shop floor tools. URL: https://princeyadav7.github.io/princeyadav.github.io/services/zoho-creator-development/
- **Custom ERP Development**: Modular ERP systems for manufacturing, inventory, and operations. URL: https://princeyadav7.github.io/princeyadav.github.io/services/zoho-erp-development/
- **API & System Integrations**: REST APIs, OAuth 2.0, Deluge webhooks, Stripe, and QuickBooks integrations. URL: https://princeyadav7.github.io/princeyadav.github.io/services/zoho-api-integrations/
- **Data Migration**: Secure CRM migration from Salesforce, HubSpot, and spreadsheets. URL: https://princeyadav7.github.io/princeyadav.github.io/services/zoho-data-migration/

URL: https://princeyadav7.github.io/princeyadav.github.io/case-studies/manufacturing-creator-erp/

URL: https://princeyadav7.github.io/princeyadav.github.io/case-studies/healthcare-operations/
